flows.title: Invite someone to collaborate on a task
steps: Open the task the collaboration is for.
Find the share button on that task.
Click it, select collaboration, and invite the people who should join.
Only the task's owner can invite collaborators, and one task holds up to 50 people including the owner.

flows.title: Set up Mail Manus so an email becomes a task
steps: Go to Settings, then Mail Manus.
Under Base Emails, configure the Approved senders — the addresses you send from, capped at ten — and note Manus's Email, the address that turns what it receives into a task.
Optionally personalise the custom address, which can be changed once every seven days, and write Custom Instructions for a workflow email, so that mail sent to it is handled the same way each time.
Send a new email, or forward an existing one, from an approved sender to that address, and Manus creates a task from its contents.
Anyone added as a recipient or cc joins the task as a collaborator.
